title: Shorter LR warmdown (WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.3)
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3, giving more time at peak LR and less time cooling down, since two other agents were already covering the depth axis this round.
reflection: val_bpb 1.015310 vs baseline 1.014027 -- slightly worse, not an improvement. Suggests the full 0.5 warmdown fraction is doing real work (stability/convergence at the end of the fixed 5-minute budget) and shouldn't be shortened; if anything a slightly longer warmdown might be worth trying in a future round, but this is a low-priority direction given the small effect size.
